crop.notes: Clipping is the 'Sporting Notes' item; the Allen notice comes first, followed by unrelated Hanlan/O'Connor rowing and Fitzsimmons/Pritchard items.

title.suggested: Notice of Tom Allen's Free and Easy, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist," at 619 Market Street, a free and easy with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, August 15, 1891, page 7.

facts.fact: In August 1891 Allen ran a free and easy at 619 Market Street with only the best singers engaged; he styled himself retired champion pugilist

notes: Item is a three-line paid notice about Allen's place; focus primary because the item is entirely about him, though 'passing' is defensible.
